label: weETH redemption rate -5 percent
description: The slashing / exploit counterfactual. This is the axis both engines' oracles actually read: the Debt Manager composite follows the weETH/ETH exchange-rate feed and the Aave cap adapter passes a rate DROP straight through (its growth cap binds upward only). This is the weETH scenario that produces liquidations; a secondary-market depeg does not - see weeth_market_depeg_oracles_held.
path_assumption: instantaneous mark at the shocked level; single-step, no path, no cascade feedback, no partial closes

propagation.note: Debt Manager marks weETH as the weETH/ETH exchange-rate feed x ETH/USD (recon/derivation-notes.md:283); base_asset is the DEPLOYED composition read from PriceProviderV2.tokenConfig(weETH).baseAsset = the native-ETH sentinel at the accept-r4 OP pin (see the pinned-read out_of_model entry)
AaveOracle cap adapter 'Capped weETH / eETH(ETH) / USD' = ETH/USD x RATIO_PROVIDER getRate(); the growth cap binds upward only, so a down-shock passes through

out_of_model: oracle lag and heartbeat behaviour during the move: the shock is applied as an instantaneous mark, while the real feeds update on deviation or heartbeat
deviation-trigger discreteness (a feed moves in rounds, not continuously)
liquidator liquidity, gas costs, execution latency and cascade dynamics
market correlations not mechanically implied by the read paths recorded in recon/derivation-notes.md
intra-sample price wicks: prices are 60-second point samples and an intra-interval spike is invisible by construction (D-012)
the mechanism that would cause a 5 percent rate drop (slashing, an exploit, a withdrawal-queue discount) is not modeled; only its mark effect is
eETH/weETH withdrawal-queue behaviour and any redemption gating

per-asset base_asset claims are the DEPLOYED composition graph read from PriceProviderV2.tokenConfig(token).baseAsset at the accept-r4 OP pin (block 154938071, hash 0xaf91dd4ba1975fc3b93e411586ce267892406ed8cb7152c5cefe1c368696c6bc, provider 0x44dd2372FE7B97C4B4D6a7d4DeCf72466485BAcB) - a hash-pinned SAMPLE with no continuity claim (chain-truth R3.1), fixture-welded in internal/risk/testdata/tokenconfig_accept_r4.json
